title: 第14章 周川示好，街头追击（求月票）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“草！刘耀文这老王八蛋，头上毛都没几根了，心眼子倒是不少。”

周川看完口供后破口大骂。

许景川说道：“刚刚为了诈陈洪搞出的声响有点大，怕惊了刘耀文导致其出逃，我已经让人盯着他了。”

“考虑得很周详。”周川露出满意之色，由衷地夸赞道：“景川你还真是没让我失望啊，走，跟我一起去见署长，这案子的首功非你莫属！”

“多谢组长提携。”许景川鞠躬。

周川拍了拍他的肩膀往外走去。

许景川紧随其后跟上。

路上，周川余光扫了他一眼笑着说道：“景川啊，我知道你因为和谢宏的矛盾导致对我也不太信任……”

“组长我……”许景川脸色骤变。

“听我说完。”周川抬手打断了他的话，继续说道：“否则你不会在我转达署长命令后还去找她求证，不就是担心我挖坑算计你吗？”

许景川面上装出忐忑的模样。

摸不透周川究竟是什么意思。

“呵呵，放宽心，我并没有怪你的意思，相反我跟署长一样，很欣赏你的魄力和本事。

我看不上一个队长的位置，而以你的本事相信未来也不会局限于区区队长，所以没必要因此闹得不愉快。

你愿意的话，回头我抽空组个局调解下你跟谢宏的矛盾，大家化干戈为玉帛，以后都是自己人。”周川语重心长、言辞恳切的释放善意。

许景川已经证明了价值。

署长定会将其收入麾下。

只要许景川听话，那这个队长由谢宏来当还是他来当又有何区别？

反正都是自己的下属。

而且他已经查到了，今早送许景川来上班的那辆车登记在盛安置业的名下。

所以没必要为个队长职位，跟一个有背景的得力下属闹得不愉快。

许景川拿不准周川是真心想跟自己和解，还是想忽悠自己放松警惕。

但以己度人，他觉得是后者。

抱着见招拆招的心思，也假意答应道：“既然组长你把话都说得那么明白了，我不答应就是不识抬举。

哎，其实我初来乍到，也无意与人起冲突，一切听您的安排。”

“好，等我消息！”周川爽朗的大笑两声，当然，他不会天真的以为这样就能彻底消除许景川的芥蒂。

不过他相信相处久了之后，许景川会看清自己的诚意。

两人交谈间到了署长办公室。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Fuck! Liu Yaowen, that old bastard, doesn't even have a few hairs on his head, but he's got a lot of tricks up his sleeve."

Zhou Chuan cursed loudly after reading the confession.

Xu Jingchuan said: "The noise I made just now to defraud Chen Hong was a bit loud. I was afraid that Liu Yaowen would be frightened and cause him to flee. I already had people watching him."

"You have thought it through very carefully." Zhou Chuan showed a satisfied look and praised sincerely: "Jingchuan, you really didn't disappoint me. Come on, come with me to see the director. You must be the first to take credit for this case!"

"Thank you, team leader, for your support." Xu Jingchuan bowed.

Zhou Chuan patted his shoulder and walked out.

Xu Jingchuan followed closely behind.

On the way, Zhou Chuan glanced at him out of the corner of his eye and said with a smile: "Jingchuan, I know you don't trust me very much because of your conflict with Xie Hong..."

"Team leader, I..." Xu Jingchuan's expression suddenly changed.

"Listen to me." Zhou Chuan raised his hand to interrupt him and continued: "Otherwise you wouldn't have gone to her for confirmation after I conveyed the director's order. Aren't you just worried that I would dig a hole to plot against you?"

Xu Jingchuan pretended to be worried.

I can't figure out what Zhou Chuan means.

"Haha, relax, I don't mean to blame you. On the contrary, like the director, I admire your courage and ability.

I don't like the position of a captain, and with your ability, I believe you won't be limited to a mere captain in the future, so there is no need to make it unpleasant.

If you are willing, I will take the time to form a bureau later to mediate the conflict between you and Xie Hong. We will turn our hostility into friendship, and we will all be our own people from now on."Zhou Chuan released his goodwill with sincere words and sincere words.

Xu Jingchuan has proven his worth.

The Director will definitely take him under his wing.

As long as Xu Jingchuan is obedient, what difference does it make whether Xie Hong becomes the captain or he becomes the captain?

They are all his subordinates anyway.

Moreover, he had already found out that the car that took Xu Jingchuan to work this morning was registered under the name of Shengzheng Industry.

So there is no need to get into trouble with a capable subordinate with a background because of a captain position.

Xu Jingchuan was not sure whether Zhou Chuan really wanted to reconcile with him, or whether he wanted to fool himself into letting down his guard.

But judging others by oneself, he felt it was the latter.

With the intention of showing off his tricks, he pretended to agree: "Since you have made it so clear, team leader, I would be disrespectful if I didn't agree.

Hey, actually I am new here, and I have no intention of causing conflicts with others. Everything is at your discretion."

"Okay, wait for my news!" Zhou Chuan laughed heartily. Of course, he would not be naive enough to think that this would completely eliminate Xu Jingchuan's grudge.

However, he believed that after getting along for a long time, Xu Jingchuan would see his sincerity clearly.

While the two were talking, they arrived at the director's office.
